start_scene_0_3s.description: RadG bedside monitor showing SpO2 reading dropping below 88%.

core_scene_3_7s.description: Demonstrates continuous real-time blood oxygen monitoring.

end_scene_7_10s.description: Recommends verifying sensor placement and ensuring CPAP airflow.

en.full_narration: Your oxygen reading was lower than expected. Wear your CPAP all night and contact your provider if low readings continue.
